character: Hybrid of permanent circuit and closed public roads, home of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Long straights (including the Mulsanne) reward low drag and reliability; the Porsche Curves reward pure commitment at the end of a long stint.
sources: https://www.24h-lemans.com/en/news/landmarks-of-the-24-hours-of-le-mans-circuit-57442 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circuit_de_la_Sarthe — Dunlop Curve/Tertre Rouge/Mulsanne Corner/Arnage/Porsche Curves verified

corners.name: Dunlop Curve
corners.type: fast sweeping section under the circuit's famous bridge
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering through the compression
corners.trap: Any hesitation here scrubs speed early in the lap

corners.name: Tertre Rouge
corners.type: fast right-hander feeding the Mulsanne Straight
corners.technique: A fast, clean exit is essential — feeds the longest straight on the lap
corners.trap: Compromising exit speed here costs time over the entire Mulsanne Straight

corners.name: Mulsanne Corner
corners.type: heavy-braking corner at the end of the Mulsanne Straight
corners.technique: Brake hard from very high speed, slowing from roughly 300 to 75 km/h
corners.trap: Misjudging the braking distance from the extreme straight-line speed

corners.name: Arnage
corners.type: slowest corner on the circuit, a tight right-angle right-hander
corners.technique: Patient, low-speed precision, prioritise a clean exit
corners.trap: Carrying too much speed in and running wide on exit

corners.name: Porsche Curves
corners.type: fast, flowing sequence taken close to flat-out by the bravest drivers
corners.technique: Commit with smooth, minimal steering corrections
corners.trap: Any correction at speed here is highly costly
